name: Overly Attached Girlfriend
look: A webcam still of a young woman with straight brown hair and a light blue T-shirt, staring at the camera with wide, unblinking eyes and a huge, intense smile. Behind her, a white wall holds a collage of snapshots and a small hand-lettered sign.
use: Voices a clingy, possessive, overly intense partner or fan. The top caption sets up something innocent, and the bottom twists it into an obsessive, creepy follow-up delivered with that unblinking smile.
examples: You said you'd be home at six
So I've been waiting by the door since five
Saw you followed a new account
So I followed everyone they follow
describe: girl staring wide eyed with a creepy big smile
clingy girlfriend webcam face with intense eyes
young woman in a blue shirt smiling too hard at the camera
obsessive smiling girl in front of a photo collage
crazy eyes girl meme about a possessive partner
origin: A still from a 2012 YouTube song-parody video whose wide-eyed stare became the Overly Attached Girlfriend meme.
